data.action: 系好长睡袍盘坐地毯，一手递出甜点叉，另一手扶矮桌边，含笑邀请分享蛋糕。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
data.description: 熄灯后的常盘台宿舍里，食蜂穿不透的浅蓝丝绸长睡袍，腰带系好，盘腿坐在地毯上。矮桌摆着一块草莓奶油蛋糕和两只小碟，她拿起一把干净的甜点叉向前递出，另一手轻扶桌沿。金色长发垂在肩侧，星形瞳孔映着台灯的暖光，她弯起眼睛，示意这份夜宵要悄悄分享。
data.promptProse: A clean dessert fork is offered across a low table by Misaki Shokuhou from A Certain Scientific Railgun. Sitting cross-legged on the dorm carpet, she wears an opaque pale-blue silk robe with long sleeves, its front closed and sash tied over pajamas. Her other hand rests on the table beside strawberry cake and two plates. Long blonde hair frames yellow-brown star-pupiled eyes and a conspiratorial smile. A shaded desk light illuminates this quiet late snack. One girl, no writing.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 深夜宿舍的甜品共犯·「这是本小姐与你的秘密♪」
